fit_prerequisite: POLICY_PAIRING_QA.json status PASS, before any fits
cohort: all 2299 frozen positive-population tracts; no imputation/exclusions
weight_meaning: squared-distance budgets; multiply cohort z-scores by sqrt(budget)
scaler: mean and population SD (ddof=0); fixed_impact uses full positive-cohort Impact-first scaler
silhouette: full 2299 cohort, weighted Euclidean, no sampling; cached pairwise distances
elbow: largest perpendicular gap to normalized K1-to-K8 endpoint chord, report curve and adjacent reduction; candidate diagnostic, not automatic scientific selection
spatial: seed42 all policies/specs/scalers K2-8; frozen TIGER internal points and prior median-UTM-x/y quadrants; leave one block out, refit policy_cohort scaler on training only or retain full fixed_impact scaler, fit n_init50, predict all; report full and held-out ARI
rare_group: exact 34 GEOIDs from prior verified A/k4/seed42 STATION Q proxy group; never redefine membership
canonical_labels: model-specific increasing mean B then population, display only; comparisons use ARI and Hungarian match
interpretation: joint statistical/scientific/seed/spatial/policy evidence, no optimized composite ranking
